rwa_usage_evidence.classification_note: Secondary trading is counted separately from RWA issuance/AUM. Kamino PAXG collateral availability is composability evidence only because fresh borrowing/collateral utilization was not quantified.

why_capital_is_arriving: Cross-category tokenized-asset secondary trading has broadened from equities into commodities while Solana stablecoin supply and spot DEX turnover remain positive. This is more substantive than issuance/AUM alone. The signal is not fully clean because 24h net bridge flow is negative and parts of the wider Raydium/Stocklana ecosystem have incentive contamination.
incentive_adjustment: DefiLlama reports zero chain-level token incentives, but protocol-specific launch/reward programs can still contaminate activity. The commodity/equity secondary-volume figures are therefore treated as substantive usage but not assumed to be entirely discretionary speculation.
wallet_quality: No fresh cohort of historically selective, independently funded SOL spot wallets was verified repeatedly accumulating during this run. Wallet-quality confirmation remains missing.
leadership_rotation: Raydium is the clearest venue-level beneficiary, reportedly routing about 70% of Solana tokenized-commodity volume and remaining a major tokenized-equity venue, but it remains structurally ineligible for a paper buy.

structural_gate_detail.SOL: PASS_WITH_CAVEATS: native asset with deep liquidity; protocol inflation/validator concentration remain economic caveats.
structural_gate_detail.RAY: FAIL: approximately 282.66M RAY remain across five project-controlled vaults versus roughly 269.7M circulating supply in the cited supply analysis; the buyback wallet separately holds about 86.25M RAY under one key and buybacks are held rather than burned. Mint authority/no-mint and liquidity checks are reassuring, but project-control and holder-concentration risk fails the hard gate.

major_uncertainties: No fresh independent selective-wallet SOL accumulation cohort was verified.
Solana 24h net inflow is negative despite positive stablecoin and spot-volume growth.
Fresh chain-specific collateral utilization for PAXG or other commodity RWAs was not quantified.
Protocol-specific incentives may explain some Raydium ecosystem activity even though chain-level token incentives are zero.
paper_action: NO_TRADE; HOLD SOL; NO ADD; RAY REJECTED
prospective_tests: Tokenized-equity and tokenized-commodity secondary turnover persists after the current catalyst wave.
Solana stablecoin supply remains positive and net bridge flow improves rather than continuing negative.
Historically selective, independently funded SOL wallets begin repeat spot accumulation.
Commodity collateral usage is demonstrated with actual borrow/collateral utilization rather than only collateral eligibility.
RAY project-control concentration materially decentralizes before reconsidering structural eligibility.
